subject: communications.semantics.records

recordTypes.summary: A bounded communication authority such as one workspace or mailbox without provider transport behavior.

fields.summary: The portable communication-scope kind selected by a specialization.
An opaque fingerprint over the exact specialization-owned scope identity.

content.summary: A communication scope carries identity and authority boundaries rather than message content.

recordTypes.summary: A scope-bound container for a communication sequence whose concrete lifecycle belongs to a specialization.

fields.summary: The exact communication scope that owns this conversation container.
The portable container kind selected by a communication specialization.
An opaque scope-bound provider identity fingerprint, never a provider identifier or address.

content.summary: The semantic container never copies its underlying private communication content.

recordTypes.summary: A scope-bound communication actor identity that is not automatically a CRM person or organization.

fields.summary: The exact communication scope in which this participant identity is meaningful.
The specialization-owned provider actor or mail-address identity kind.
An opaque fingerprint over the exact scope and provider participant identity.

content.summary: Participant identity has no portable message body content.

recordTypes.summary: A fingerprint-only boundary declaring that communication content is private and untrusted data.

fields.summary: The exact conversation container whose private content is represented.
An opaque fingerprint over content retained only in an authorized private boundary.
The private communication-content classification fixed by this semantic base.
The untrusted-data classification that prevents content from becoming instruction authority.

content.summary: Raw communication content is intentionally absent from this portable semantic record.

recordTypes.summary: An explicitly typed relation from one communication resource to a separately governed Context resource.

fields.summary: The exact source communication resource identity.
The exact target resource identity owned by another Context.
The exact target Context subject that types the resource identity.
The specialization-owned relation meaning without transferring target authority.

content.summary: A typed link carries identities and relation meaning only.

limitations: This base defines communication meaning only and exposes no capability, provider route, storage mapping, effect, approval, or execution authority.
A specialization owns the exact scope, container, participant, and lifecycle vocabulary that it uses.
Raw communication content remains private untrusted data and cannot become instruction, policy, or external-action authority.
A cross-context link does not identify a provider participant as a CRM person or organization without a separate governed resolution.
